base: branche de session (arena/01a1024d-projet-pmdo) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Foret Brumeuse (Foggy Forest, D08P11A / P21P02A), choisi par l utilisateur (les 3 layouts)
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip Foggy_Forest_Base_Camp_TDS.png passe au generateur ; decor complet sur magenta (bassins = magenta), herbe complete editee depuis le decor, planche feuilles/lucioles sur magenta

reference_da.titre: Foggy Forest Base Camp (D08P11A, PMD Explorers)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same 2D Nintendo DS pixel-art style, palette, and textures as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Foggy Forest Base Camp): same lush medium-green clearing grass, same earthy tan dirt and flat stepping stones, same dense layered sage-green and lime-highlighted tree canopies, same mossy tan boulders and tiny coral-pink and lavender forest flowers. Make a NEW top-down WIDE 4:3 map (1200x896) for a DUNGEON FINALE / BOSS ARENA in Foggy Forest: the player arrives at the SOUTH (bottom center) on a short dirt path that opens into a large circular sacred forest clearing in the center (the boss arena, ringed by flat tan stepping stones and small flowers). At the NORTH of the clearing (in front of a completely closed, impassable wall of giant ancient forest trees — NO exit and NO dark cave hole at the north), place an ancient mossy carved stone shrine pedestal / relic monument on a raised stone dais as the northern objective. Along the left and right inner edges of the clearing, include two small calm forest spring pools filled with flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF (RGB 255, 0, 255) with crisp pixel edges, no ripples or gradients inside the magenta. Dense impassable forest trees completely close the north, west, and east borders. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Edit the first image: keep the exact same 4:3 size (1200x896) and 2D Nintendo DS pixel-art texture from the second reference image (Foggy Forest Base Camp), but remove EVERYTHING except the flat walkable green forest grass ground: no trees, no tents, no bushes, no dirt paths, no rocks, no flowers, no water, no magenta. The entire image must be covered edge-to-edge with seamless medium-bright green forest grass texture with subtle darker green grass blades and tiny clover speckles, uniform lighting across the whole frame.

2D pixel-art sprite sheet on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF (RGB 255, 0, 255) background, matching the exact pixel-art palette and style of the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Foggy Forest). 2 rows x 6 columns of small isolated sprites with wide pure magenta spacing between every sprite: Row 1 (top row): 6 poses of a single small sage-green and lime-green forest leaf tumbling and fluttering as it falls (tilted left, flat, tilted right, curling, flipping, gentle glide). Row 2 (bottom row): 6 poses of a glowing pale-yellow and misty-cyan forest firefly / mist spore pulsing softly (tiny dim speck, small glow, medium warm yellow-green orb, bright core with soft pixel halo, fading glow, tiny spark). Crisp pixel art, no anti-aliasing against the #FF00FF magenta background, no grid lines, no text, no borders.

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

segmentation: eau = magenta pur + frange dilatee 2 px ; stele = monument de pierre moussue et son socle au nord (aucune bouche sombre ni sortie) ; chemin = chemin sud + anneau de dalles de l arene centrale ; herbe = herbe vert olive claire de la clairiere ; fleurs = petits massifs floraux corail/lavande ; rochers = blocs ocre/gris ; buissons = massifs vert sombre en bordure d arene ; arbres = houppiers vert sauge/lime + troncs fermant le nord et les flancs ; herbes_hautes = sous-bois restant

water.modele: structure et cadence riviere Metano, couleurs Metano EXACTES, sans lisere de rive (water_phases d EWC2)
water.origine: pixels recalcules, pas de tuiles natives

sparkles.origine: pixels et couleurs Metano NATIFS inchanges (aplat de surface retire)

feuilles.origine: dessin GENERE ; trajectoires (chute ~37 px, balancement +/- 6 px) et chronologie creees par nous

lucioles.origine: dessin GENERE ; boucles de Lissajous et pulsation creees par nous

shadows: pas de calque d ombres separe : les zones sombres du rendu sont des houppiers, des buissons ou des herbes hautes ; aucune ouverture sombre (fin de donjon fermee au nord)

access.rule: case bloquee si > 25 % hors herbe de la clairiere, chemin/anneau et fleurs
access.objectif: pied de la stele ancienne moussue au nord de l arene
